name: Afterglow
description: The pointer leaves a glow on the screen that fades where it was, the way a phosphor screen keeps a faint image of what was just drawn. Wherever the pointer passes the glow is refreshed, and everywhere else it dims a little each frame until it is gone. The glow is kept on its own canvas from one frame to the next, so a long stroke fades along its whole length rather than being cut off behind the pointer.
author: PlasmaZones

parameters.name: Persistence
parameters.description: How much of the glow survives from one frame to the next. Higher values fade more slowly

parameters.name: Brush radius
parameters.description: Radius of the glow the pointer lays down as it moves (px)

parameters.name: Intensity
parameters.description: Brightness of the glow where it is freshest

parameters.name: Fresh colour
parameters.description: Colour of the glow where the pointer has just been

parameters.name: Faded colour
parameters.description: Colour the glow shifts toward as it dims
